leads.title: Bermuda Human Rights Act 1981, amended 2013
leads.documents: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation since 2013; core anti-discrimination machinery
leads.detail: No URL shown in text. Cited as: 'Since 2013, the Human Rights Act has prohibited discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation' and 'In 2013, the Parliament of Bermuda approved legislation that prohibits discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation' referencing Human Rights Act 1981, section 2(2)(a)(ii) as read with section 5

leads.title: Supreme Court of Bermuda - Godwin and DeRoche marriage case, May 2017, Justice Charles-Etta Simmons
leads.documents: Ruled denial of marriage license discriminatory; held Marriage Act 1944 inconsistent with Human Rights Act; legalized same-sex marriage
leads.detail: No URL shown in text. Cited as: case brought by Winston Godwin and Greg DeRoche denied license July 2016; Justice Charles-Etta Simmons historic ruling May 2017

leads.title: Domestic Partnership Act - passed December 2017, Royal Assent 7 February 2018, in effect 1 June 2018
leads.documents: Replaced same-sex marriage with domestic partnerships; described as first territory to reverse marriage rights by legislation
leads.detail: No URL shown in text. Cited as: new PLP Government passed law December 2017; Governor gave royal assent 7 February 2018; went into effect 1 June 2018; British Crown did not challenge

leads.title: Supreme Court ruling 6 June 2018 and Court of Appeal ruling 23 November 2018 on Domestic Partnership Act
leads.documents: Struck down/revoked parts preventing same-sex couples marrying; stay for appeal then upheld, allowing marriages to resume
leads.detail: No URL shown in text. Cited as: two challenges filed by April 2018, heard May 2018, ruling 6 June 2018 with stay; Court of Appeal upheld 23 November 2018

leads.title: Judicial Committee of the Privy Council ruling 14 March 2022 with July 2022 retrospective legislation
leads.documents: Ruled for Attorney General appealing Court of Appeal, banning same-sex marriage again; followed by July 2022 laws to retrospectively backdate legality prior to March 2022
leads.detail: No URL shown in text. Cited as: 'On 14 March 2022... ruled for the Attorney General' and 'In July 2022, laws were passed... to retrospectively backdate same-sex marriage legality formally prior to March 2022'

leads.title: Supreme Court adoption ruling February 2015, Hellman J
leads.documents: Found direct discrimination on marital status and indirect on sexual orientation in adoption denial; Adoption of Children Act applies equally to married/non-married and same-sex couples
leads.detail: No URL shown in text. Cited as: 'In February 2015, Judge Hellman J of the Supreme Court... handed down a ruling' on adoption application

leads.title: Criminal Code - Stubbs Bill 1994 and 1 November 2019 amendment; gross indecency repeal
leads.documents: Legal status of homosexual activity; 1994 legalization of consensual conduct in private with unequal age of consent 18 vs 16; 2019 reform setting 18 for anal intercourse and repealing gross indecency between men
leads.detail: No URL shown in text. Cited as: Prior to 1994 anal/oral sex punishable up to ten years; Stubbs Bill 1994; violation of European Convention on Human Rights; law took effect 1 November 2019; as of 2022 age still not equal

leads.title: Barker, Nicola (2016). Public Law article
leads.documents: Academic/legal analysis of impact of European Convention on Human Rights on LGBT rights in Bermuda as British Overseas Territory
leads.detail: Further reading citation visible: Barker, Nicola (2016). leads.title: 2006 Government attempt to ban Mark Anderson / drag queen 'Queen of Bermuda' Sybil from parade
leads.documents: Documents difficulty of gender identity/expression; government stated participation contradicted local mores and sensitivities
leads.detail: No URL shown in text. Cited in Gender identity and expression section: 'in 2006, the Government attempted to ban Mark Anderson, also known as the drag queen "Queen of Bermuda" Sybil, from participating in a parade'

leads.title: November 2020 DVD gay porn / obscene behaviour law enforcement case
leads.documents: Documented enforcement incident: individual charged/threatened with jail for importing DVDs of gay porn under archaic obscene behaviour law; government spent ~£150,000 to appeal unconstitutional case
leads.detail: No URL shown in text. Cited as: 'In November 2020, it was reported and discovered that the government of Bermuda spent approximately £150,000 to legally appeal an unconstitutional court case...'
